title: Qt: Disable a I/O Graph Dialog's UAT when the capture file is closed
description:
All I/O Graph Dialogs share the same UAT. There can be only one
capture file open, but there can exist dialogs that referred to
a now closed file. Those dialogs can't do retaps or recalculations
that involve accessing the file, though they can do some QCustomPlot
transformations, which means that some controls work and some don't.

Disable the controls that don't work when the file is closed. Remove
the model, so that updates to the model from dialogs with the open
file don't change what's displayed on the dialog for the closed file.
This does unfortunately get rid of some of the displayed information
about the current graphs.

Ping #19055

+     for the currently open file.)
+
   ** Temporary graphs that have just been added and will not be saved
